name: SOICT 2026
full_name: The 15th International Symposium on Information and Communication Technology
summarization: SOICT 2026 is an international symposium covering significant research areas such as AI Foundations and Big Data, Networking and Communication Technologies, Multimedia Processing, AI Applications, Generative AI, Applied Operations Research and Optimization, and Recent Advances in Cyber Security. The event provides an academic forum for researchers and graduate students to share their latest research findings and identify future computer science challenges. It features tutorials and keynotes given by world-class speakers, with proceedings published in the Springer CCIS series.

name: RIVF 2026
full_name: The 20th International Conference on Computing and Communication Technologies
summarization: RIVF 2026 is the 20th International Conference on Computing and Communication Technologies, serving as a major scientific event for researchers, professionals, and students in the field of computing and communication technologies. The conference covers topics such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, computer vision, and cybersecurity, providing a platform for presenting cutting-edge research and networking. It features paper presentations, tutorials, special sessions, and keynote speeches delivered by prominent academics.

name: AICON 2026
full_name: 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks
summarization: The 6th EAI International Conference on Artificial Intelligence for Communications and Networks (EAI AICON 2026) focuses on artificial intelligence methods and systems that directly advance communication technologies, network infrastructures, and connected autonomous systems. It brings together researchers, engineers, and practitioners working at the intersection of AI, communications, and networking, targeting AI-enabled design, optimization, operation, and protection of wireless, mobile, satellite, optical, Internet of Things, software-defined, and cloud-edge networks.
location: Phu Quoc Island, An Giang, Vietnam

name: ICEEIS 2026
full_name: 1st International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Intelligent Systems 2026
summarization: The ICEEIS 2026 conference provides an international forum for researchers and professionals to share recent advances and foster collaboration in electrical, electronics, and intelligent systems. Topics cover artificial intelligence, intelligent control, robotics, renewable energy, smart grid, embedded systems, IoT, mechatronics, wireless communications, and power electronics. It is organized by HCMC University of Technology and Engineering (HCM-UTE), Vietnam.

deadlines.name: Full paper submission (applicable to IEEE Track)

name: AMI 2026
full_name: The 1st International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Autonomous Machine Intelligence (AMI 2026) is an international forum dedicated to the study of autonomous, self-supervised, and predictive learning systems. The conference aims to bring together researchers and practitioners to advance the foundations and applications of next-generation intelligent systems capable of learning and acting with minimal human supervision, focusing on emerging paradigms such as world models, energy-based models, and joint embedding predictive architectures.

name: ICEBA 2026
full_name: The 12th International Conference on E-Business and Applications
summarization: ICEBA 2026 aims to address essential complexities in e-business by inviting papers focusing on systems, software, services, and enterprise-oriented digital transformation. The event encourages researchers, practitioners, and enterprise leaders to share cutting-edge research, practical transformation cases, and insights on how e-business empowers enterprise growth and innovation. Key thematic areas include intelligent tech for enterprise digital transformation, innovative cross-border e-business service models, and sustainable cross-border e-business development.

name: REV-ECIT 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin
summarization: The 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology (REV-ECIT 2026) covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a special focus on national strategic technologies.

name: AICI 2027
full_name: The Eighth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence
summarization: The International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Computational Intelligence aims to bring together researchers to present and discuss theoretical and applied research problems in artificial intelligence, computational intelligence, and related soft computing techniques. The event provides an opportunity for international scientists, academics, and students to foster research collaborations. The audience includes leading researchers, practitioners, and students specializing in AI and related fields.
location: Thang Long University, Nghiem Xuan Yem Road, Dinh Cong District, Hanoi

name: ICIIT 2027
full_name: 2027 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology
summarization: The 2027 12th International Conference on Intelligent Information Technology (ICIIT 2027) serves as an interactive forum for presentation and discussion on Intelligent Information Technology and related fields. It brings together researchers and participants from all over the world to establish professional ties and explore career opportunities in the region. The event accepts full papers and abstracts for presentations across various IT topics.

name: ICCIES 2027
full_name: The 3rd International Conference on Computational Intelligence in Engineering Science
summarization: ICCIES 2027 is an annual international academic forum providing a platform for researchers, academics, and professionals to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and explore innovations, recent advances, and emerging trends in intelligent computing across a broad range of engineering disciplines, including Information Technology, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, and the Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. Organized by Ton Duc Thang University and co-hosts, the conference brings together universities, research institutions, and industry to foster international collaboration and networking.
location: Ton Duc Thang University, Ho Chi Minh City

name: AAMAS 2027
full_name: The 26th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2027)
summarization: AAMAS 2027 is the 26th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems, serving as the largest and most influential conference in the area of agents and multiagent systems. It brings together researchers and practitioners to present the latest developments in agent and agentic technology.

name: MobiSys 2027
full_name: The 25th ACM International Conference on Mobile Systems, Applications, and Services
summarization: ACM MobiSys 2027 aims to showcase innovative and impactful research on the design, implementation, usage, and evaluation of mobile computing and wireless systems, applications, and services. It is sponsored by ACM SIGMOBILE and builds on the success of the previous twenty-four ACM MobiSys conferences.

name: EASE 2027
full_name: International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering
summarization: EASE 2027 is the 31st edition of the International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering, serving as a leading venue for academics and practitioners to discuss evidence-based software engineering and its implications for software practice. The event welcomes high-quality submissions across multiple tracks including research papers, short papers, industry papers, posters, and doctoral symposiums. It will take place in Hanoi, Vietnam.

name: WCST 2026
full_name: 4th World Conference on Smart Tourism
summarization: The World Conference on Smart Tourism focuses on synergizing industry and academia by harnessing artificial intelligence for transformative tourism and hospitality in the Global South. It brings together researchers and professionals to discuss smart tourism developments, tracks, posters, and undergraduate pitching.

name: TSE 2026
full_name: 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems
summarization: The 2026 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Search & Rescue and Emergency Response Systems (TSE 2026) provides a forum for exchanging ideas, discussing research results, and presenting cutting-edge innovations at the intersection of science, technology, and emergency management. The conference brings together researchers, engineers, practitioners, policymakers, and industry leaders to address challenges in search and rescue operations and emergency response.

name: SIMC 2026
full_name: The First International Conference on Semantic Intelligence in Massive Computing (SIMC)
summarization: SIMC 2026 is a specialized forum bringing together researchers and industry experts to discuss advances in semantic intelligence for massive computing environments like cloud, edge-fog architectures, and IoT. The conference focuses on integrating semantic modeling, knowledge representation, reasoning, and artificial intelligence to enable meaningful data interpretation and intelligent decision-making. Accepted papers will be published in the Lecture Notes in Electrical Engineering (LNEE) series by Springer and indexed in Scopus.

name: CSoNet 2026
full_name: The 15th International Conference on Computational Science and Network Intelligence
summarization: CSoNet 2026 is an interdisciplinary conference focusing on theoretical foundations, methodological advances, and real-world applications of computational intelligence, network science, and data-driven methods in modern systems and networks. It serves as a forum for researchers and practitioners to present original research covering topics such as network intelligence, graph-based methods, computational science, artificial intelligence, and complex systems applications. The event brings together academics and industry professionals to exchange ideas and explore emerging directions in network learning and structure-aware AI.
location: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT), Ho Chi Minh City

name: ICTA 2026
full_name: The 5th International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology (ICTA 2026)
summarization: The 5th International Conference on Advances in Information and Communication Technology (ICTA 2026) aims to provide an international forum for researchers, academics, industry experts, and practitioners to exchange innovative ideas, research findings, and practical experiences in the field of Information and Communication Technology (ICT). The conference focuses on the rapid convergence of Artificial Intelligence (AI), advanced ICT infrastructure, and cybersecurity technologies transforming modern societies, smart cities, and digital industries. It welcomes original research papers, case studies, and innovative applications across topics such as AI, intelligent data systems, cybersecurity, smart cities, and intelligent industry.

name: ICDSAIA 2026
full_name: International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications
summarization: The International Conference on Data Science, Artificial Intelligence and Applications (ICDSAIA 2026) is a venue for experts, researchers, and innovators to explore recent advancements in data science, artificial intelligence, and their practical applications. Attendees engage with thought leaders, collaborate with peers, and discover groundbreaking solutions shaping these fields.
location: East Asia University of Technology, Phan Tay Nhac Street, Xuan Phuong Ward, Hanoi

name: AIEI 2027
full_name: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Energy and Infrastructure
summarization: AIEI 2027 is the second edition of the international conference dedicated to artificial intelligence for energy systems, resilient infrastructure, and sustainable cities. The event brings together researchers, academics, engineers, industry professionals, and students to discuss responsible, reliable, and impactful AI solutions across smart energy, infrastructure, AI and data, and reliability. Hosted by COSARI at Van Lang University, it features peer-reviewed proceedings, keynote presentations, and special sessions.

name: IEEE SMC 2027
full_name: 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics
summarization: The 2027 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2027) focuses on systems science and engineering, cybernetics, and human-machine systems under the theme "Human-AI Symbiosis: Engineering Intelligent, Autonomous, and Sustainable Futures". It provides an open international forum for researchers, engineers, and industry experts to discuss challenges and design intelligent systems prioritizing human well-being and societal sustainability.
location: Sheraton Saigon Grand Opera Hotel, Ho Chi Minh City

name: FJCAI 2027
full_name: FJCAI 2027 Hội thảo khoa học về Trí tuệ nhân tạo
summarization: FJCAI 2027 is an annual national academic conference on Artificial Intelligence, bringing together researchers, lecturers, graduate students, and experts in AI to exchange and share the latest research results, development trends, challenges, and applications across various fields such as machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, generative AI, and AI applications.
location: Trường Đại học Công nghệ Thông tin và Truyền thông Việt - Hàn (VKU), Đà Nẵng

name: IEEE NICE–TEAS ASIA 2026
full_name: 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA
summarization: The 4th IEEE Networking International Conference on Emerging Trends in Expert Systems, Applications & Security, ASIA focuses on networking, expert systems, applications, and security. It brings together researchers and professionals from over 20 countries to connect, collaborate, and innovate, with proceedings published by IEEE.

name: ENASE 2027
full_name: Evaluation of Novel Approaches to Software Engineering
summarization: The mission of ENASE is to be a prime international forum to discuss and publish research findings and IT industry experiences with relation to novel approaches to software engineering. The conference acknowledges evolution in systems and software thinking due to contemporary shifts of computing paradigms to AI-assisted coding, low-code/no-code platforms, cloud and edge computing, security and DevSecOps, IoT integration, and sustainable engineering. ENASE aims at identifying most hopeful trends and proposing new directions for consideration by researchers and practitioners involved in software design, programming, integration, deployment, delivery, maintenance and evolution.

name: GCHRCLI 2027
full_name: Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation
summarization: The Global Conference on Human Rights, Cybersecurity & Legal Innovation (GCHRCLI) provides an international platform for academicians, researchers, engineers, industrial participants, and students to share research findings, network, and establish collaborations in human rights, cybersecurity, and legal innovation.

name: ICCSS 2027
full_name: 2027 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation (ICCSS)
summarization: The 10th International Conference on Circuits, Systems and Simulation (ICCSS 2027) invites scientists, engineers, technicians, and graduate students to share research experiences and ideas in circuits, systems, and simulation. The conference provides a platform for exchanging updated research knowledge and publishes accepted papers in its conference proceedings.

name: 8th IEEE AICAS 2026
full_name: 2026 IEEE 8th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS 2026)
summarization: The 8th IEEE International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS 2026) is a flagship event for the IEEE Circuits and Systems Society focusing on cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence circuits and systems. It brings together researchers and professionals to discuss topics such as in-memory computing, hardware/software co-design, neuromorphic circuits, and emerging AI applications.

name: REV 2026
full_name: Hội nghị Quốc gia lần thứ XXIX về Điện tử, Truyền thông và Công nghệ Thông tin
summarization: REV-ECIT 2026 is the 29th National Conference on Electronics, Communications and Information Technology organized by the Radio-Electronics Association of Vietnam (REV). The conference covers topics across electronics, communications, and information technology, with a particular focus on national strategic technologies.

name: ICE 2027
full_name: ICE IEEE/ITMC
summarization: The ICE 2027 conference invites high-quality papers presenting substantial, original, and previously unpublished research across the topics of engineering, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship. The event serves as a premier international forum for researchers, practitioners, and innovators to discuss advancements in smart manufacturing, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, sustainable engineering, and entrepreneurial ecosystems.

name: ICERA 2026
full_name: 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications
summarization: The 9th International Conference on Engineering Research and Applications (ICERA 2026) serves as an international forum for sharing recent research, theories, and practices in engineering research, applications, and economics. It welcomes submissions across various tracks including mechanical engineering, materials, mechatronics, automotive, electrical and electronics, information and communication technology, and economics.
